# Lab 14.10: Enable Private Google Access

## What We Are Going to Do
Show that a VM with no external IP cannot reach Google APIs, then fix it with Private Google Access on the subnet.

## Steps

1. **Create a subnet without Private Google Access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks create pga-vpc --subnet-mode=custom
gcloud compute networks subnets create pga-subnet --network=pga-vpc \
  --region=us-central1 --range=10.60.0.0/24
gcloud compute firewall-rules create pga-iap --network=pga-vpc --allow=tcp:22 \
  --source-ranges=35.235.240.0/20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create a private VM and a bucket.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create pga-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --subnet=pga-subnet --no-address --scopes=cloud-platform
gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-pga --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Try to reach Cloud Storage.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh pga-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap \
  --command="timeout 20 gcloud storage ls gs://$PROJECT_ID-pga || echo FAILED"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It times out.

4. **Enable Private Google Access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks subnets update pga-subnet --region=us-central1 \
  --enable-private-ip-google-access</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Try again.** The same command now lists the bucket. Traffic stays on Google's network and the VM still has no public IP.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete pga-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-pga
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete pga-iap --quiet
gcloud compute networks subnets delete pga-subnet --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks delete pga-vpc --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Before | Google APIs unreachable |
| After | Google APIs reachable, no external IP |
| Setting level | Per subnet |
| Internet access | Still none, that needs Cloud NAT |
